velocity_lifecycle.completion_semantics: T_v is S-curve completion; T_full is the first feasible nominal horizon; existing FF fade starts at T_full
velocity_lifecycle.preload: none; e_p and p_ref are not changed
velocity_lifecycle.lean_completion: solver-constrained zero-lean/zero-rate endpoint at first feasible T_full; never the next command time

horizon_search.threshold_basis: V1 engineering threshold, not a theoretical feasibility theorem

velocity_lifecycle.feedforward_exit_input: last solved nominal interval input; no cruise nominal solve
